audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike claims Purgatory 'struggles' because she dashes out of the totem radius, so the page tells the reader their ultimate does nothing in the one matchup where it does the most.
audit.why: Purgatory grounds. A grounded Riven cannot use Broken Wings or Valor to leave — she has to walk out of the zone, on foot, while sitting above an execute threshold. That is the single reason this lane has any window at all, and the mirror has already been corrected to say exactly this, so the two pages must agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors beyond the grounding. The page calls Blade of the Exile 'a second-charge burst' and 'a repositioning tool' and says her 'R re-cast' lets her disengage — per Riot's text R grants Attack Damage and Range plus a single Wind Slash, with no dash and no reposition. Ki Burst also appears everywhere with no range or cooldown.
audit.why: A player who thinks her ultimate is an escape plays around a button that cannot escape, and misses that the real threat of R is the extra range on a champion who otherwise has to be inside 275 to touch you.
audit.corrected: late, spikes[3].text, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now describe R as AD, range and one Wind Slash, and give Ki Burst's 260 range / 11s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining stun had no number, and sequencingCues was 1 for the whole page.
audit.why: Ki Burst at 11s against your flat 10s blink is the only clock that lets a 425-range dasher approach a champion with three Q dashes on 13s.

edits.before: Even at 6 Purgatory struggles: her Blade of the Exile (R) gives her range and a second-charge burst, and her Q mobility lets her dash out of your totem radius before the execute lands.
edits.after: At 6 Purgatory finally answers her: it grounds, so Broken Wings cannot carry her out — she walks clear of the zone while Blade of the Exile (120s at rank 1) burns down.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are her strongest window. Her full kit — three Q dashes, Valor (E) shield, and Ki Burst (W) stun — lets her out-trade you and cancel your E reset with the stun. Your totem at 6 barely helps because her Q mobility and Blade of the Exile (R) let her dash clear of the execute radius. This whole stretch is hers; play for farm and jungle help.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are her strongest window. Her full kit — three Q dashes, Valor (E) shield, and Ki Burst (W, 11s at rank 1) stun — lets her out-trade you and cancel your E reset with the stun. Your totem at 6 changes that: Purgatory grounds, so she cannot dash clear and must walk out above the execute floor. Farm until then.

edits.before: Post-items Riven stays ahead. Her shield absorbs your W-burst opener and her mobility means every commit you make can be dashed out of, while her R gives both extra damage and a repositioning tool. This is a mechanics matchup where her mobility hard-counters your need to stick to a target — win it with ganks and roams, not solo duels.
edits.after: Post-items Riven stays ahead.
